subject: Evaluation criteria, success metrics & timeline — Redwood next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@novaedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation criteria, success metrics & timeline — Redwood next steps

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick synthesis of the discovery so we have shared expectations and a proposed mutual action plan (attached). I tried to keep this tight — please flag anything that needs to change.

Top pain points you shared
- High tail latency on batch inference during peak shopping windows (~95th percentile spikes to 700–900ms).
- Cost volatility when running ensemble rerank + multi-model scoring, especially on longer contexts.
- Limited visibility into per-request token breakdowns and model drift alerts.

Stated goals (what success looks like)
1) Sub-200ms 95th percentile on user-facing rerank path for 1k concurrent sessions.
2) 30–40% predictable reduction in per-token inference cost versus current setup (measured over 30 days).
3) Ship observability hooks and quality guards so product owners can detect regressions within 24 hours.

Proposed pilot scope (what we think we can execute quickly)
- Pilot target: rerank flow for Search A/B group (approx. 50k tokens/day).
- Duration: 4 weeks of live traffic + 1 week of warmup/validation.
- Success metrics: latency SLO, average cost per 1k tokens, and precision@10 quality hold.

Suggested milestones & owners (high level)
- Pilot kickoff call (define traffic slice & logging) — owner: Grace O'Connor — target: 2027-07-05
- Infra prep & security review (VPC, KMS, SOC2 evidence) — owner: Tom Wu (NovaEdge) / Redwood security — target: 2027-07-12
- Pilot run (live traffic) — owner: NovaEdge product & Redwood CS (Monica) — target: 2027-07-19 to 2027-08-16
- Pilot close + decision meeting — owner: Sara Patel & Ben Carter — target: 2027-08-20

Next steps (action items)
1) Sara: confirm the pilot cohort (search rerank group) and legal/procurement contact for SOW (who should be on the 1:1 procurement thread?).
2) Tom: confirm whether NovaEdge requires an on-prem connector or VPC peering for the pilot.
3) Redwood: share SOC2 summary, MPA spreadsheet, and a draft SLA — attached.

Attachments included:
- redwood_mpa_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan — editable milestones)
- redwood_sla_draft.pdf (SLA + latency targets)

I've also linked the HubSpot record for this deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/HS-4392

If this looks right, I'll lock the kickoff date and get Monica to schedule the pilot-run cadence with your ops folks.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Sara Patel <sara@novaedge.com>

Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaedge.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation criteria, success metrics & timeline — Redwood next steps

Thanks Grace — this is a very helpful summary. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Confirmed pain/goal alignment: latency and cost predictability are the priority for Q3. Observability is a close second.
2) Procurement/legal: we loop in procurement (procure@novaedge.com) and our GC for SOW review.
3) Security: we will need SOC2 + network diagram and an outline of data retention for logs.

On the pilot scope, 50k tokens/day seems reasonable for a small cohort. Two asks from my side:
- Can you provide an estimated cost range for the pilot (ballpark) and an option to cap spend?
- Will Redwood support token-level tracing for troubleshooting during the pilot?

Also looping Tom to confirm the VPC peering requirement — Tom, do we want to try a temporary VPC peering test or use a short-lived API key to start?

Onward — happy to confirm the kickoff date once Tom confirms peering.

Best,
Sara Patel
Director of Product, NovaEdge

Sara — thanks, great questions. Short answers below and a couple of additions.

Cost & spend cap
- Pilot estimate (ballpark): $1,200–$1,800 / week for the proposed classifier + reranker profile at 50k tokens/day depending on batching and KV cache reuse. We can set a hard budget cap via rate-limited keys for the pilot.

Token-level tracing
- Yes — Redwood can enable request-level token breakdown and a trace ID for every request so your engineers can correlate latency spikes to specific prompts. We will surface those traces in the Console and stream a subset to your S3 for deeper analysis during the pilot.

Security artifacts
- Attached: redwood_security_onepager.pdf (SOC2 summary + network diagram) and a one-page list of retention defaults. If you need the full attestation, we can coordinate an NDA + SOC2 bridge call.

Pilot technical approach (brief)
- We will deploy a dedicated pool for the pilot with prefix caching enabled for repeated rerank prompts.
- Continuous batching tuned to your request distribution to preserve P95 targets while improving cost.

Updated milestones (action owners inline)
- 2027-07-05: Kickoff call — Grace (Redwood) / Sara (NovaEdge) — confirm cohort and logging hooks
- 2027-07-12: Security & network validation (VPC peering decision) — Tom (NovaEdge) / Redwood security — deliver: network runbook
- 2027-07-19: Pilot go-live (warm traffic window 3 days) — Monica (Redwood CS) / NovaEdge infra
- 2027-08-16: Pilot analysis complete — deliver: latency + cost report; decision meeting scheduled for 2027-08-20

Related links:
- Security pack (preview): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cSecurityPack
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/HS-4392

I'll attach the SOC2 one-pager and the MPA workbook (editable). Ben, Monica — could you review the milestones and flag any internal gaps?

Thanks,
Grace
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear plan. Two quick procurement notes from my side: 
1) Procurement will want a formal SOW + fixed pilot quote to attach to our purchase request. Can Redwood provide a one-page SOW and a PDF quote by 2027-06-25?
2) Legal will want to review by 2027-07-20 to meet our internal Q3 budget approval.

We prefer a short-lived VPC peering test for the pilot if Redwood can support it; it simplifies our audit requirements. I'll introduce procure@novaedge.com on the next thread.
